name: UI
description: Free, open source React components with smooth micro-interactions, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. Copy the code into your project and make it yours.

paragraphs: Kinetik is a free, open source library of animated React components with smooth micro-interactions, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. Add a component with one shadcn command and the source lands in your project: no package to keep updated, nothing hidden, and every line yours to change.

Kinetik is not an npm package. Every component is source code that lands in your app, so you can change anything and there is no package to keep updated. Install one with a single shadcn CLI command, or copy the files by hand. Each component has a docs page with a live preview, the full source, an install command, a setup guide and its props.
features: Writes every file to the right path, keeping folder components together (components/ui/prompt-input/).
Installs the npm packages, pinned to the versions Kinetik is tested with.
Pulls in the Kinetik components it builds on. Prompt Input brings Model Selector; Segmented Navigation brings Button.
Adds the design tokens (--ui- variables and @utility rules) to your global CSS.
Skips files you already have, such as lib/utils.ts, and asks before overwriting anything else.
